links.outcome: Rates of major harmful recommendations and hallucinated or fabricated information in LLM responses to implant complication vignettes
links.effect: Hallucination and harmful recommendations occurred and varied by model; DeepSeek V3.2 had the highest rates, and Gemini 3.1 scored highest and outperformed DeepSeek V3.2 in all domains.
links.quote: DeepSeek V3.2 had the highest rate of major harmful recommendations and hallucinated or fabricated information.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation comparing the diagnostic accuracy, management appropriateness, and safety of four LLMs on clinical vignettes regarding implant-related complications.
